[h1]The Classrooms: 0.7 "The Kidrooms" Update Out Now! 🎈😱[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42721145/92a1c99ab478ad5ffd52ae7d7d0bae041eeae84b.gif"][/img][/p][p]Hello, brave investigators of [i]The Classrooms[/i]! The 0.7 "The Kidrooms" update is LIVE, and it’s our biggest yet! Step into the eerie, toy-strewn chaos of [b]The Kidrooms[/b], face the unpredictable [b]Joey[/b], and beware the creepy [b]Arachnophone[/b]. This update is packed with new scares, refined gameplay, and a ton of polish to make your VHS-fueled nightmares even more intense. Ready to dive into the Superstructure’s latest twisted corner? Let’s break it down!
[/p][h2]Welcome to The Kidrooms! 🧸[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42721145/f103cac084e666fc8cca44e11974a0b2b5fee736.gif"][/img][/p][p]The Kidrooms is a brand-new procedurally generated level that’s equal parts nostalgic and unsettling. Picture a maze of colorful playhouses, oversized slingshots, and creepy toys, all steeped in that signature [i]Classrooms[/i] liminal dread. Navigate through vents, dodge new puzzles, and uncover secrets in this warped playground. With diverse rooms and improved generation for smoother flow, The Kidrooms is a fresh, replayable terror-fest. Oh, and watch out for those orange balloons—they’re not just for show! 🎈[/p][p][/p][h2]Meet Joey: The Demon Dog 🐶💥
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42721145/21f6f908ac00f8e0a14dd7eb62b3f874246c170d.gif"][/img][/h2][p]Say hello to [b]Joey[/b], the shape-shifting canine terror who’s anything but a good boy. This entity switches between a deceptively cute [b]Small Dog[/b] and a ferocious [b]Big Dog[/b] (and sometimes a [i]Super[/i] version that’s OVER 9000!). Joey’s got new tricks:[/p][list][*][p][b]Biscuit Distraction[/b]: Toss biscuits to calm him down—each one lowers his anger, but don’t expect him to stay friendly for long.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Vent Crawling[/b]: Joey now prowls through vents, making nowhere safe.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dynamic Behavior[/b]: From sniffing sounds to glowing eyes and ragdoll physics, Joey’s animations and AI are next-level. He’ll chase, bark, and even get mad if you hit him with a gumball![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Joey’s kill cutscene is chilling, and his transformations pack a visual punch. Can you outsmart this furry fiend? 
[/p][h2]Arachnophone: The Creepy Gramophone 🕷️🎶[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42721145/6e07e8a9a7f4c9b052f39fd98ab34353c2c50f02.gif"][/img][/p][p]The [b]Arachnophone[/b] is here to crank up the fear! This gramophone with a sinister twist scuttles around The Kidrooms, triggered when you get too close, and sent packing when you land a hit. Here’s what makes it tick:[/p][list][*][p][b]Transforming Terror[/b]: After a 1-second delay, it morphs into a spider-like nightmare if you venture too near or hit it three times.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sound Traps[/b]: Its alarm enrages Joey, so tread carefully.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hiding Mechanics[/b]: Smack it to send it back into hiding, but don’t expect it to stay down for long.[/p][/*][/list][p]With four Arachnophones lurking in The Kidrooms, you’ll need sharp reflexes and a steady hand to survive their eerie tunes.
[/p][h2]Custom Keybinds: Control Your Fear 🎮[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42721145/13960317f733c716a62a8eb838ef4b726191adb2.png"][/img][/p][p]Take charge of your survival with the new keybinds system! Customize controls for both keyboard and controller to suit your playstyle, whether you’re sprinting from Joey or aiming a slingshot. Rebind actions in the pause menu or main menu for a seamless, panic-free experience. Your fear, your rules![/p][p][/p][h2]Equipment System: Gear Up on the Fly 🛠️[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42721145/ec356aee731cb13fbe4cbd8cee685b561ef81426.gif"][/img][/p][p]Wield your arsenal like a pro with the revamped equipment system! See your character’s hand gripping each item for extra immersion as you fend off horrors in The Kidrooms.[/p][p][/p][h2]Overhauled Audio: Amplify the Terror 🔊[/h2][p]The Kidrooms sound more chilling than ever with our overhauled audio system! Fearful chase music blares when danger’s near or Joey’s on your tail, keeping your pulse racing. Explore too long without a scare? Eerie exploration music sets in, lulling you into a false sense of safety. Every sound pulls you deeper into the nightmare![/p][p][/p][h2]Other New Gameplay Features 🎮[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42721145/b4a1a4f3c5fabc54c78ee45b66ad19c1c9adb816.gif"][/img][/p][p]We’ve cranked the immersion to 11 with these additions:[/p][list][*][p][b]Slingshot Minigame[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Piano Puzzle[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Canine Death Whistle[/b][/p][/*][/list][h2][/h2][h2]Bug Fixes, Optimizations, and General Improvements 🛠️[/h2][p]We’ve squashed hundreds of bugs to make your experience seamless.[/p][list][*][p]Patched crashes, lighting glitches, and tile generation errors.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved performance with optimized navmesh, ragdoll physics, and reduced hitches.[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced entity navigation around corners and doorways for smoother pursuits.[/p][/*][*][p]Refined Bathrooms' level generation to prevent entities from getting stuck.[/p][/*][*][p]Boosted Gangler spawn reliability in Bathrooms for consistent scares.[/p][/*][*][p]Upgraded Screecho’s animations for more fluid and terrifying movements.[/p][/*][*][p]Polished player animations, camcorder model, and flashlight placement for a more immersive experience.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Community Support 👋[/h2][p]Your feedback shaped this update! From refining procedural generation to adding vents and keycards, we’ve listened to your posts on Discord and the The Classrooms Wiki. Keep sharing your thoughts via Discord or the Steam forums—we’re already planning more scares, including that multiplayer mode you’ve been asking for![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42721145/9e4af47dc69703b4a53a3c20ca050c749d634557.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42721145/513c12ec29fea511a32441261c2a744a8771170a.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]What’s Next? 👀[/h2][p]Multiplayer and Tape 8 are “Coming Soon,” and we’re not stopping there. Expect more entities, levels, and maybe a few surprises as we march toward the full release. Stay tuned, and don’t forget to update to 0.7 to explore The Kidrooms![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42721145/a33275cba84123c6474294f9dd43a00ea78398e1.gif"][/img][/p][p]Grab your VHS camcorder, stock up on batteries, and survive the [i]The Kidrooms[/i]—if you dare. Share your creepiest moments with us using #TheClassrooms, and let’s see who can outrun Joey and the Arachnophone![/p][p]Stay scared,
The [i]The Classrooms[/i] Team[/p]

[h1]The Classrooms - April Update: Take Control of the Terror![/h1]

Greetings, brave explorers of the unknown! It’s time to rewind the tape and step back into The Classrooms with our latest update, rolling out this April. We’ve been hard at work in the shadowy halls, and we’re thrilled to unveil some fresh changes—starting with a feature you’ve been asking for: 

[h2]Customizable Key Bindings![/h2]
Now, you can tailor your controls to fit your playstyle as you navigate the endless, twisting corridors. Whether you’re sprinting from unseen horrors or managing your scent to stay hidden, the power to remap your keys is yours. Head to the settings menu and make The Classrooms feel just right—or as right as anything can feel in this nightmare.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42721145/1d0cbf8b538f09444844524e421f0919c7e4d22e.png[/img]

[h2]April 1st Update[/h2]
But that’s not all lurking in this update. On [b]April 1st[/b], expect [spoiler] [DATA EXPUNGED][/spoiler] . Let’s just say the entities you’ve come to fear might [spoiler] [REDACTED][/spoiler]  in ways you won’t see coming. Keep your eyes peeled (if you dare) for something… unexpected.

[h3]Additional Changes[/h3]

[b]Bug Fixes: [/b]Entities can now hear you properly—no more sneaking by with a broken soundscape. We’ve also squashed some pesky general bugs and fixed a glitch where you could peek inside your own body (not a recommended survival tactic).

[b]Smell Trail Upgrade: [/b]The scent mechanic is sharper than ever, making your every move a calculated risk.

[b]Inventory Optimization:[/b] Item icons are now leaner, reducing memory usage and keeping your experience smooth.

[b]Added Missing Computer Lab Library Tile in Tape 1[/b]

[b]Tape 3 Level Generation:[/b] Improved procedural layouts mean every run feels fresher and more unpredictable.

This update is all about giving you more control—over your keys, your survival, and maybe even your sanity. Dive in this April, and let us know what you think on the Steam forums or our Discord. Your feedback keeps the tapes spinning.

Stay vigilant,
The Classrooms Team

[spoiler]And a little whisper from the shadows: the next level and multiplayer are creeping closer. Stay tuned—more horrors (and friends to face them with) are on the way soon.[/spoiler]

[h1]The Classrooms 0.6.5 Update[/h1]
We’re excited to share our latest update! This update focuses on engine improvements, performance boosts, and a host of new settings to help you fine-tune your experience. Check out the highlights below:

[h2]1. Engine Upgrade & Stability Improvements[/h2]
New Engine Version: Upgraded to a more stable and feature-rich engine—this is also the version we’re using for our upcoming multiplayer update. Expect smoother performance and enhanced stability across the game!
[h2]2. Graphics Settings Overhaul[/h2]
[list]
[*] Quality Presets: Quickly select between Low, Medium, High, Ultra, and a specialized Steam Deck preset optimized for handheld play.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42721145/392af98ab52c994b73ae510e6f04463f2a5594de.gif[/img]
[*] Advanced Customization: Fine-tune your visuals with individual graphics options, including:
[*] LOD Bias
[*] Shadow Resolution
[*] Ambient Occlusion
[*] Screen Space Reflections & Shadows
[*] Subsurface Scattering
[*] Texture Quality & Texture Streaming
[*] Mirror Reflections
[*] Anisotropic Textures
[*] Light Distance & Draw Distance
[*] Particle Raycast Budget
[*] Skin Weights & Hair Effects
[*] Anti-Aliasing
[*] Motion Blur & Depth of Field
[*] VHS Bleed, White Line Tape Noise, & Scanlines
[*] Advanced Lens Effects
[*] Water Effects
[*] Alembics
[*] DLSS (Experimental): Leverage NVIDIA’s Deep Learning Super Sampling on supported systems for better performance and sharper visuals.
[/list]
[h2]3. Performance Enhancements[/h2]
[list]
[*] New LODs for Props: We’ve introduced multiple Levels of Detail to props, substantially improving performance in The Poolrooms and all other Tapes.
[*] Optimized Tapes: Further tweaks and optimizations yield better frame rates throughout every Tape.
[*] Improved Vent Culling: Enhances performance in areas with heavy vent usage.
[/list]
[h2]4. World & Content Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Interactable Props: Many additional objects now feature physics-based interactions for greater immersion.
[*] Lockers in Poolrooms: Keep an eye out for loot in lockers—you never know what you might find.
[*] Playrooms Lighting Overhaul: Enjoy a more atmospheric experience with revamped lighting.
[*] Improved Models: Various levels now showcase upgraded models for a crisper and more polished look.
[/list]
[h2]5. Bug Fixes & Tweaks[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed Centipede Footstep Sounds
[*] Resolved Missing Stairwell Wall
[*] Removed Santa Hat for certain entities during non-holiday death cutscenes
[*] Corrected Glitchy Wall Lamps in Library
[*] Fixed Floating Light Switch in certain bathroom tiles
[*] Anti-Gravity Objects Bug Squashed
[*] Removed Redundant Splash Screen
[*] Fixed mic bar occasionally not detecting footsteps and physics sounds
[/list]
[h2]6. New Features & User Options[/h2]
[list]
[*] Profanity Filter: Toggle on to replace strong language with safer alternatives.
[*] Reset to Default Settings: Roll back all settings to their original state if needed.
[/list]
Thank you for your support and feedback! We hope these upgrades provide a smoother, more customizable experience. Keep the feedback coming, and stay tuned for more updates—especially our upcoming multiplayer release.

Enjoy the 0.6.5 update, and we’ll see you in The Classrooms!

[h1]The Classrooms - 0.6 Update: Welcome to the Playrooms![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42721145/e9e24af567982e25d6de9be45c9a9c85a1770a33.gif[/img]
After the incredible success of The Poolrooms update, featuring the terrifying Whispering Wyrm, we're excited to announce our latest major content drop: The Playrooms. For the first time, our team has been able to dedicate all our time and energy to this project, and we can't wait for you to experience what we've been working on!

[h2]New Environment: The Playrooms[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42721145/61a3882379dd585b5bd46b60d003047a430b4d75.gif[/img]

Step into The Playrooms, a sprawling and seemingly friendly play zone suspended in an infinite void of darkness. What appears to be a nostalgic space for childhood memories quickly turns into a surreal and disorienting labyrinth, where faint echoes of the past twist and distort. Traverse endless paths, take on platforming challenges, and uncover the hidden depths of this eerie environment.


[h3]Explore two special areas within The Playrooms:[/h3]

[b]Chewtopia:[/b] Indulge in the atmosphere of a classic '90s fast food joint, complete with retro aesthetics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42721145/e6cda8abd6e6175f06ce7b7431040ccc71516949.gif[/img]

[b]Froggy's Ticket Arcade:[/b] Engage in a variety of mini-games and win tickets! Try your hand at spin wheels, basketball, timing challenges, skee ball, Tic Tac Toe, and more. Trade your hard-earned tickets for prizes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42721145/0cdcc24f3c5c62a0b8239061be3f482e934351cb.gif[/img]

[h2]New Entities: The Necropede and The Tenant[/h2]

[b]The Necropede:[/b] A monstrous, wall-crawling centipede that carries a head and stalks its prey with unnerving precision. Watch out as it lurks in the shadows, waiting for the perfect moment to strike.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42721145/8683e95504fdc3942f8d692a8ea21592085fa51d.gif[/img]

[b]The Tenant: [/b]A large, eerie stone head with grotesque red appendages. The Tenant uses its writhing tentacles to detect movement and drops leeches that roam the environment. These leeches latch onto potential prey and release a pungent gas to alert The Tenant. Be quick to squish them before they have a chance to give you away!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42721145/a59263cc9cb23f4245e7b8e6abd41015176a3753.gif[/img]

[h3]New Mechanic: Smell[/h3] 

We've introduced a new mechanic that changes the way you interact with the environment and entities: Smell. As you move around, running and jumping, your smell meter gradually increases. If you let it build up too much, you'll start to stink, attracting the attention of entities that rely on smell to hunt. Manage your scent by using deodorants or other methods to stay under the radar and avoid unwanted attention.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42721145/66747e1676c0602de4efa8968c6f857023eb7edf.gif[/img]

[h3]Character and Gameplay Enhancements[/h3]

[b]New Player Model: [/b]Robert Chen, our protagonist, has received a complete makeover! The new model boasts higher quality visuals and is fully rigged for advanced facial animations, allowing for a more immersive and emotional experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42721145/4b6e51538d204c41798a3e99a58f6e33f31a7728.gif[/img]

[i](Fun Development Image We Took When Testing Facial Animations)[/i]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42721145/5f715c3cd13ed0b2bc68f3185da6f54ca2259f5f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42721145/0472853a1d1b1209e3907cf440533067c19f2e27.png[/img][/url]

[b]Improved Animations and IK:[/b] We've fixed various animation bugs, making movement and interactions smoother and more realistic.

[b]Object Throw Mechanics: [/b]Objects now have specialized throwing physics. For example, basketballs have a natural upward trajectory and backspin, making gameplay more intuitive and engaging.

[h3]Lore and Storytelling[/h3]
[b]New Lore Documents: [/b]Uncover more secrets of the Superstructure with newly added documents that shed light on its mysterious origins.

[b]Lore Tapes: [/b]Discover three new lore tapes that delve into the histories of the three organizations operating within the Superstructure, providing more context and depth to the world of The Classrooms.
Additional Improvements
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42721145/9e83cc8f310422eaa475469719f484096790d645.gif[/img]
[b]Enhanced Enemy AI: [/b]Enemies now navigate the environment more reliably, creating more intense and dynamic encounters.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42721145/abc23a1ab6695a18085056d67c3a22f7ce3f3a3f.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42721145/cede61696a09f06cf708a3d53e7778b7bbb5dd06.gif[/img]
Improved Water Interactions: Water ripples are now more realistic, enhancing the visual immersion and interaction with water surfaces.

[b]Gangler Audio Updates: [/b]Experience a more atmospheric and chilling encounter with improved audio for the Gangler entity.

[h3]Custom Mode Overhaul[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42721145/bfb123030d45191940824cf46a2754e4954304d7.png[/img]
You can now customize the abilities of each entity in Custom mode including hearing, sight, smell, freeze when looked at, etc. This way you can make your own crazy combinations of entities and abilities to create fun challenges!

We're incredibly excited for you to dive into this update and explore everything The Playrooms have to offer. As always, we look forward to your feedback and can't wait to hear about your experiences with the new content!

Thank you for your continued support, and happy exploring!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42721145/9eb35cdaf7ec26d055be3f150a2c7c3b7124b7c5.gif[/img]
